title: Treasury Administrator
description:
Who we are

GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.

Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Why join GlobalData?

GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey, and we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world s most successful organisations.?

Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast-paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.

The role

We now have an opening for a Treasury Administrator within the Treasury Team based in Hull. Working within the finance team, we expect you to have close interaction with the wider commercial business, with the main responsibility being production of daily bank reconciliations and processing of payments.

Now is an incredibly exciting time to join and be part of a business that is fast-paced, vibrant and ambitious, with opportunities for everyone to develop and succeed.

What you ll be doing
- Producing daily bank reconciliations in multi currencies
- Cash allocation of bank receipts and payments
- Resolving cash allocation queries
- Ledger maintenance
- Liaising with purchase ledger, credit control
- Creation of manual purchase ledger payments
- Bank and credit card administration

What we re looking for
- AAT Qualified, or experience of working in a similar role.
- Technical skills - with strong Excel skills and analytical ability.
- Dedicated and accountable - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail and effectively managing expectations.
- Organised - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail as well as managing expectations effectively.
- A strong communicator - able to communicate well and build strong, collaborative relationships across the business.
- Adaptable and positive mindset - a confident personality with a positive attitude towards change and new challenges.

In addition to a rewarding career, we support our GlobalData colleagues with a range of benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel, tech and more. To find out more about the roles and benefits on offer in your region, visit (url removed)

GlobalData believes strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

title: Account Coordinator
Office Coordinator
description:
Office Coordinator

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,000 - 28,000 per annum (dependent on experience)
Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:00am - 4:30pm, Friday 8:00am - 1:00pm

The Company

Our client is a well-established specialist manufacturer whose products and associated service plans are supplied to customers across the globe. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit an organised and proactive Office Coordinator to support a range of business functions and play a key role in the day-to-day running of the office.

The Role

As Office Coordinator, you will provide administrative support across multiple departments, helping to ensure projects, installations, customer requirements and internal processes are managed efficiently.

This is a varied position that would suit an individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and takes pride in delivering excellent support to both customers and colleagues.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and compiling accurate installation and project documentation
- Coordinating travel arrangements, including booking flights, hotels and transport for engineers and management teams
- Processing employee expense claims and maintaining accurate records
- Supporting customers with enquiries and providing a professional point of contact
- Assisting colleagues across various departments with administration and coordination tasks
- Maintaining customer records, documentation and filing systems
- Organising meetings and supporting diary management where required
- Producing reports, correspondence and general business documentation
- Supporting the smooth running of office operations and business processes
- Ensuring all paperwork is completed accurately and within required timescales

The Person

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and confident managing multiple priorities.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Office Coordinator, Office Administrator, Administration or Business Support role
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- A professional and customer-focused approach
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Experience arranging travel and processing expenses would be advantageous
- Experience within a manufacturing, engineering or technical environment would be beneficial, although not essential

What's On Offer?
- Salary of 27,000 - 28,000 per annum
- Early finish every Friday
- Stable Monday to Friday working hours
- Varied and interesting role supporting international operations
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Opportunity to develop within a growing specialist manufacturing business

If you are an organised and proactive administrator looking for a varied role within a successful manufacturing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You ll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We re looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data. If you would like to read our privacy policy, please go to our website (url removed) where you will find all the information you need to know about how we will use and process your personal data.

You can also follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn for up to date jobs and other helpful information.

title: Project Administrator
company: Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Administrator
Location: Brough
Salary: Up to £30,000 depending on experience
Short Description
Enjoy Variety, Build Relationships and Put Your Technical Skills to Good Use
Do you enjoy working with technical information, organising customer orders and seeing projects come together? This could be a great opportunity to build on your existing skills in a varied and rewarding role.
Consortium Professional Recruitment are delighted to be working with an established business to recruit a Technical Project Administrator. Joining a friendly, close-knit team, you'll be involved in a range of customer projects, working with colleagues, customers and suppliers to keep everything running smoothly.
The Opportunity:
As a Technical Project Administrator, your role will include:
- Reviewing technical drawings and specifications to support accurate order processing.
- Processing customer orders and coordinating project information.
- Liaising with customers and suppliers regarding quotations, orders and lead times.
- Keeping project records up to date and tracking progress.
- Working with colleagues to resolve queries and support successful project delivery.

You'll enjoy plenty of variety and the opportunity to be involved in projects from initial enquiry through to completion.
About You:
We're interested in hearing from people who enjoy combining technical information with administration and customer service.
Ideally, you'll bring:
- An ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
- Experience in administration, order processing or project support within a technical environment.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A friendly, practical approach to communication and problem-solving.
- Familiarity with Excel and digital systems would be beneficial.

Your background could be in technical administration, sales administration, project coordination, engineering, manufacturing or construction.
You don't need to have held the same job title before. We welcome applications from people with relevant transferable skills who are looking for their next opportunity.
The Benefits and Package:
- Salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience.
- A supportive, close-knit working environment.
- A varied role with involvement across different stages of customer projects.

How to Apply:
This Technical Project Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment.
If you enjoy working with technical information, supporting customers and keeping things organised, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every aspect of the role, we encourage you to get in touch.
Please apply with your CV attached.

Consortium Professional Recruitment are working on a retained basis with a well-established UK services business to recruit a Finance Assistant. title: Financial Services Administrator
description:
Financial Services Administrator

Beverley

£27,000-£30,000

NJR Recruitment is working with a well-established and growing financial planning practice in Beverley to recruit an experienced Financial Services Administrator to join its dedicated support team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a background in financial services administration who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in delivering exceptional client service and is looking to develop their career within a supportive and professional team.

Working closely with Financial Advisers, you will play an integral role in ensuring the smooth running of client administration, supporting the team with new business processing, client queries, provider liaison and maintaining accurate client records.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing new client applications and onboarding, ensuring all paperwork is completed accurately.
- Supporting the processing of client investment transactions in line with internal procedures and compliance requirements.
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and complete outstanding administration.
- Managing client queries and providing a professional, efficient and friendly service.
- Liaising with providers to obtain plan, policy and scheme information.
- Assisting with technical calculations, including carry forward allowances, critical yield analysis and Inheritance Tax calculations.
- Maintaining accurate client records and updating CRM systems.
- Inputting and checking client fact-find information.
- Preparing reports and presentations to support Financial Advisers with client meetings.
- Ensuring all administration is completed accurately and in line with FCA and compliance requirements.
- Contributing to the improvement of internal processes and procedures.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- At least 2 years' experience within a Financial Services Administration role.
- Experience working within an IFA or financial planning environment.
- A good understanding of financial services products, processes and FCA requirements.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, and ideally experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM system.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage and prioritise a varied workload.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- A proactive, positive approach and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,000-£30,000 depending on experience.
- Discretionary bonus scheme of up to 15% of salary.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Workplace pension.
- Death in service benefit of 4 x annual salary.
- Opportunities for salary progression and further development.
- A supportive working environment within an established and growing financial planning business.
- Early finish on Fridays

If you have experience within financial services administration and are looking for your next opportunity within a supportive financial planning practice, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact NJR Recruitment for a confidential discussion quoting NJR100071

title: Administrative Assistant
description: Hull West & Central Locality Team are looking to recruit a highly motivated Band 2 Administration Assistant. They will be primarily based within the Hull Community Mental Health Team in Hull East but may be required to work at West on occasions. Will be required to deal with calls and enquiries from service users, staff and other agencies on a daily basis. They will be expected to support the team with general administrative issues and support the senior band 3 administrators with their role as necessary. Applicants will be expected to have previous experience of working in a busy office environment and be able to display a high standard of communication, organisational and interpersonal skills. Applicants should be self-motivated and a committed team player with the ability to work both individually and as part of a team. The ability to prioritise workloads, maintain flexibility in response to change and have a proactive approach to work is important; as is the ability to maintain a calm, positive attitude and use of initiative when dealing with unexpected situations. The post holder will receive regular supervision and attend relevant training identified through Knowledge and Skills Framework processes and their Appraisal review. Please note that this advertised vacancy does not meet the UKVI eligibility requirements for a Skilled Worker Visa and therefore HTFT would not be able to issue a Certificate of Sponsorship for this role. Answering phone calls and taking and passing of messages to relevant clinicians. Preparing and editing letters and emails. Maintaining the storage of files/folders on servers. Covering reception. Inputting on Lorenzo System. Adding/Closing of CPA's, Clusters, Access Plans and referralsDiary management. General Office Duties. For further information for this vacancy please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification.

title: Administrator
company: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
description: Band 2 Administrator Womens and Childrens Hospital Part time position Have you ever thought about working for the NHS? Behind every appointment, every clinic, every patient seen - there is someone who made it happen. Our Administrators are the unseen heroes of patient care. The reassuring voice on the phone. The organised mind behind the clinic list. The calm presence supporting patients in what can often be their most worrying moments. Without them, patients don't get seen. Services don't run. Care doesn't flow. We are recruiting Administrators to join our team in the Paediatric Secretaries dept, Womens & Childrens Hospital. You don't need previous NHS experience - we can teach you the systems. What we can't teach is compassion, professionalism and the ability to care about getting things right for patients. That's what we're looking for. What you'll bring: A caring and compassionate approach Confidence communicating with patients and the public Good organisational skills and attention to detail Basic IT skills (typing, email, data entry, use of computer systems) The ability to work as part of a close-knit team Calmness in a sometimes fast-paced environment What you'll gain: The chance to make a real difference every single day One of the best pension schemes available Generous annual leave entitlement - because you work hard and deserve proper time off Structured training and ongoing support Genuine career progression - many of our senior leaders began in administrative roles Patient care is at the heart of everything we do, and our administrative teams are central to making that care possible. If you are organised, compassionate, and want a role where your work truly matters, we would love to hear from you. For further details with regard to this vacancy opportunity, please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification. We reserve the right to close the advert early in the event of high levels of interest. Therefore, early applications are encouraged. As a result, we are unable to issue a Certificate of Sponsorship for this position. We are managing the recruitment for this vacancy directly and are not seeking support from recruitment agencies or third-party sourcing providers.
